title: False positives in multilevel models for longitudinal data: lagged and concurrent effects, prior-outcome control, person-mean centering, AR(1) residuals, and the RI-CLPM
description: Simulations of when multilevel models for longitudinal data (y on x at t-1, or concurrent within-person effects) produce false positives, and which specifications fix them: controlling for the outcome's prior score, person-mean centering, AR(1) residuals, and the random-intercept cross-lagged panel model (RI-CLPM). A factorial varies the outcome's stability, the within-wave and trait correlations, the number of waves, and a true lagged effect, and includes concurrent within/between models with and without the prior outcome. Write-up: https://johnflournoy.science/lagged_mlm/.
